card.name: Range words inside dosing tables
card.fires_on: The word "than" in "to less than" or the "to" or "<" in a range, right after a first number in a weight, age or day band in a dosing table. It fires when the upper limit of the band comes next.

modes.label: less than
modes.description: "than" in "X to less than Y" weight or age bands.

modes.label: to / < in ranges
modes.description: "to" or "<" between the two ends of a day, weight or age range.
modes.example: Days 1 to 4 0.25 mg once daily Days 5 to 8 0.5 mg once daily Days 9<< to>> 12 0.75

card.writes: It seems to push toward the upper number of a range and away from words like "mid" or "intermediate".
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing table where the top number of a weight, age or day range is about to appear.
